question: give top 5 customers by revenue
sql:
SELECT c.id, c.name, SUM(o.total_amount) AS total_revenue
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: give report of top products and the location they are sold most
sql:
WITH product_region_sales AS (
    SELECT p.id AS product_id,
           p.name,
           c.region,
           SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2025
    GROUP BY p.id, p.name, c.region
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           name,
           region,
           revenue,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY revenue DESC) AS rn
    FROM product_region_sales
)
SELECT product_id,
       name,
       region,
       revenue
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1;
